_swall11_specials_basis: 1.21.11's bed and shulker box special models (javap class_10500 / class_10511 and their Unbaked records, class_825 / class_834) on 26.1's: the whole bed (head and foot, BedRenderer.submitSpecial) and the shulker box posing itself by its orientation are the layer's 26.1 subclasses facade/LegacyBedSpecialRenderer / LegacyShulkerBoxSpecialRenderer; BedRenderer.submitSpecial and ShulkerBoxRenderer.getExtents(orientation, openness, consumer) are 1.21.11's bodies on 26.1's submitPiece / getExtents(openness), reaching a mod's own override through its adapter (rt/CbWallBed, rt/CbWallShulkerBox)
_swall11_specialblocks_basis: 1.21.11's SpecialBlockModelRenderer (class_10418, gone: 26.1 keeps a block's special model in its block model) is facade/SpecialBlockModelRenderer with 1.21.11's body; SpecialModelRenderers.createBlockRenderers bakes 1.21.11's block table (rt/CbWallSpecialBlockMap, generated by core/tools/gen_wall_specialblocks.py from javap) into renderers posing themselves as 1.21.11's did; ModelManager.specialBlockModelRenderer() is baked once per reload (rt/CbWallSpecialBlocks)

net/minecraft/class_10455.<init>(Lnet/mi.basis: 26.1's baked SpecialModelWrapper(renderer, properties, transformation) applies the transformation its unbaked form gave it; 1.21.11's baked wrapper (javap class_10455) had none and submitted the renderer as it was: the identity

adapterHooks.basis: 26.1's ModelManager has no specialBlockModelRenderer(); a 1.21.11 model manager's own override is what 1.21.11's callers got, so the layer reaches it through this interface (CbWallSpecialBlocks.specialBlockModelRenderer)

26.1's BedRenderer has no submitSpecial (its bed item draws one part per special model); a 1.21.11 bed renderer's own submitSpecial is what 1.21.11's whole-bed special model drew, so the layer reaches it through this interface (CbWallBed.submitSpecial)

26.1's ShulkerBoxRenderer.getExtents takes no orientation; a 1.21.11 shulker box renderer's own getExtents(orientation, openness, consumer) is what 1.21.11's special model asked, so the layer reaches it through this interface (CbWallShulkerBox.getExtents)
